examples.title: Basic Card
examples.description: Card with header and content
examples.code:

  <Card.Header>
    <Heading level={3} data-size="sm">Card Title</Heading>
  </Card.Header>
  <Card.Content>

examples.title: Card with Footer Actions
examples.description: Card with footer containing action buttons
examples.code:
<Card data-color="neutral" data-size="medium">
  <Card.Header>
    <Heading level={3} data-size="sm">Card Title</Heading>
  </Card.Header>
  <Card.Content>
    <Paragraph data-size="sm">Content</Paragraph>
  </Card.Content>
  <Card.Footer>
    <Stack direction="horizontal" justify="end" gap="sm">
      <Button data-variant="tertiary">Cancel</Button>
      <Button data-color="accent">Save</Button>
    </Stack>
  </Card.Footer>
</Card>
